profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Lowe's Companies, Inc.
profile.summary: Software Engineer specializing in visual analytics applications

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Co-led the development of "Optimus," an AI-driven space optimization system deployed across 1,756 stores. Enabled faster, data-backed merchandising resets, significantly improving efficiency for Visual Space Planners.

- Successfully migrated the platform from legacy on-premise infrastructure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) in 2025 to improve scalability and performance.

- Delivered critical data and application solutions across Command Center, Competitive Intelligence, and Category Management. Engineered high-availability pipelines (Airflow, Power BI) and live reporting tools for vendors using a modern stack of Spring Boot (Kotlin), React (TypeScript), and Python.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed web applications for the Data Analytics and Computational Intelligence (DACI) department for both data science and data engineering teams.

- Assisted in the planning, design, full-stack development, and production deployment of the Data Ingestion Platform (DIP)—a tool for streamlining data ETL into Lowe's on-prem big data platform.
 
- Lead developer of the Severe Weather Inference Tool (SWIFT), an analytical tool for intelligently placing orders during severe weather events, using ML sales predictions compiled by a team of data scientists to guide ordering decisions. This included full-stack development with React, PostgreSQL, Spring Webflux, and Kafka.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Bioinformatics Programmer II
positions.description:
- Lead developer for the Cell Reprogramming Database (CReD) portal—a web application for uploading, sharing, processing, and analyzing scRNA-seq, microscopy, and electrophysiology data across multiple research groups (cred-portal.com).
- Officially released the CReD portal at the National Cooperative Cell Reprogrammed Cell Research Groups (NCRCRG) and Convergent Neuroscience 2019 Consortium Meeting
- Processed and analyzed cortical RNA-Seq data using Python/R and Jupyter
- Designed web pages with AWS S3, React, and Ant Design to promote initiatives such as the San Diego Covid Research Enterprise Network  (screen-covid.info) and the Diversity Science and Lecture Series (dasl-ucsd.info)
- Initiated wet-lab scientists to our cluster computing environment. Instructed them on basic Linux commands, how to setup their software environment, and  how to submit jobs to the cluster's Portable Batch System
- Designed architectures with AWS—EC2, Elastic Beanstalk, Route 53, SQS, S3, etc, Python/Django, ReactJS, and Ant Design

positions.title: Research Engineer
positions.description:
- Contracted by the Defense Threat Reduction Agency (DTRA) to create web applications that visualize genetic pathogen data across time and space (HDTRA1-16-C-0010)
- Developed an automated pipeline for discrete trait ancestral state reconstruction in conjunction with centrality indices to analyze transmission networks of pathogens
- Managed a team of developers utilizing agile methodology and provided monthly technical reports to DTRA
- Full-stack development experience with Spring MVC, R/Shiny, MongoDB, Neo4j, D3, Sigma.js, and React
- Wrote the algorithm used to generate transmission graphs in StrainHub (https://github.com/abschneider/StrainHub)

company.name: University of North Carolina at Charlotte

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Created an automated functional database testing framework for Touchworks EHR using FitNesse, SQL, Java, and C#.
- As of June 2020, the custom FitNesse fixtures were still being used as part of the Touchworks EHR build process.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Created and deployed a Django web application for accessing DNA/RNA sequences of venom-encoding genes.
- Maintaining the web application and PostgreSQL database deployed at  http://echinodb.uncc.edu. 
- Daily activities consist of advanced shell scripting, Python/Go/JavaScript/HTML/CSS programming, and the modification of large databases using MySQL and PostgreSQL.

positions.title: Dean's Ambassador
positions.description:
- Responsible for organizing networking events for the College of Computing and Informatics.
- Creating pamphlets, logos, and other media using Adobe Illustrator.
- Recruiting high school and transfer students into CCI.

positions.title: Research Technician
positions.description:
- Assembled and annotated the hexaploid Avena sativa chloroplast and mitochondrial genomes using MIRA. 
- Implemented sorting and matching algorithms on 50+ GB of Ion Torrent paired-end reads using Python scripts executed on HPC Clusters.
- DNA and RNA extraction using Quiagen DNeasy and RNeasy extraction kits.
